article.title: Louisiana's Revolutionary: The Making of Imam Jamil al-Amin
article.author: Cierra Chenier
article.content: "Individuals do not create rebellions, conditions do." —Imam Jamil al-Amin (née H. Rap Brown), 1969. Excerpt from Which Way USA? Black Views On Race. Imam Jamil Abdullah al-Amin, the Black Power revolutionary and political prisoner formerly known as H. Rap Brown, died in federal prison on November 23, 2025 at the age of 82.
